name: @surfingdog/hosted
description: Many inboxes on one machine: a router that finds each inbox by the name it is asked for, shards that keep them open, and a signed admin API for whoever runs them.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/hosted.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
